newsitem.title: USA: Brent steady to weaker in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent steady to weaker in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: Bellwether North Sea Brent was steady to weaker in late U.S. paper trading on Thursday, traders said.
Two full cargoes of June Brent changed hands at $18.07 and $18.12 a barrel.
Four partial cargoes traded for a total of 350 lots at a steady $18.12.
June Brent settled at $18.12 on London's IPE.
May/June Brent traded twice at minus 22 and minus 20 cents a barrel, slightly stronger from today's earlier trades.
June/July moved at minus 11 cents a barrel, also up from afternoon talk.
